emma: Quick announce: Windowed-Prefix Sampler (WPS) is on canary.
emma: High-level: instead of eagerly writing every prefix to KV cache, we sample/warm a sliding window of high-value prefixes per session. This reduces redundant KV churn and keeps cache working set smaller.

bench-bot: Canary summary (3% traffic, shard group B): p50 latency -15.3%, p95 -12.1%, p99 -28.4ms, token-cost -11.2% vs baseline.

li: Which models/workloads?

emma: Tested on rw-chat-13b, redwood/4k-q, and rw-7b-quant with a mix of search, short chat, and long summarize flows. Synthetic replay with top-15 prompt families included.

carlos: Any impact on generation quality / prefix-hits?

emma: Measured prefix-hit-rate improved for hot patterns (~+9%), cold noise reduced. Quality (LM evals) within noise (<0.25% variance). Added an escape hatch: if session-level perplexity increases >0.7% we stop sampling and fallback to existing write-through.

deploy-bot: Canary finished 1749990016 123Health checks: green.

priya: Rollout plan?

emma: Staged: 3% -> 10% (8h) -> 40% (24h) -> 100% (48h) with automated gating on p99 and perplexity.

ops-bot: Dashboards added: `wps.p99_latency`, `wps.token_cost_delta`, `wps.prefix_hit_delta`. Alerts: p99 > baseline+40ms for 10m or perplexity_delta > 0.7%.

li: PR + config: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8120
li: ```
kv_cache:
  sampler: windowed-prefix-sampler-v1
  window_size: 5
  sample_rate: 0.65
  fallback: write-through
```

carlos: Nice win 14Thanks team, please post graphs to #eng-runtime later.

emma: Will do first thing tomorrow AM. :tada:
